name: aux-signal-switch
description: CANDIDATE, NOT YET FLASHED. Switch to AUX when an AUX signal appears. Stock firmware has no such path: C_HMI_MEDIA_APP_BASE::HandleAudioAuxInputStatusChnged runs only on AUDIO_AUX_INPUT_STATUS_CHANGED (0xcb, the saved Auxiliary_Status setting) and tests the setting; the real signal event AUDIO_AUX_SIGNAL_STATUS_CHANGED (0xcc) reaches the media app's DBUS dispatch and is dropped (read; see docs/AUX_SIGNAL.md). Edits 1-4 make the handler query C_BCM_HMI_AUDIO_CLIENT::Get_AUX_signal_status instead of Get_aux_status; edits 5-12 add a 0xcc case to the dispatch that goes to the same handler. Executed under tools/ppcemu.py on the stock NAV 5.43.A.R2 image with the handler's callees stubbed: the patched handler activates AUX when the signal appears and the setting is 0, releases it when the signal is lost, and ignores setting-only changes; the patched dispatch sends 0xcc to the handler and every other id where stock sends it. Not executed: anything outside those two functions, and whether the unit measures AUX while another source is playing (not known - check on the car first, see docs/AUX_SIGNAL.md). Pair with aux-boot-restore (so the activation passes PrOnly 0) and aux-sticky (a paused phone otherwise loses the signal and the scheduler falls back to the tuner). NAV only.
summary: the AUX handler reads the **signal** instead of the setting, and the media dispatch sends the signal event (`0xcc`) to it; pair with `aux-boot-restore` and `aux-sticky`

patches.why: handler: `stb r0,8(r31)` -> `stb r0,0x10(r31)`. Zero the query's result byte (a stack local) before the call, so a failed query reads as no signal. The store it replaces is dead: 8(r31) is a stack local that both branches at 0x023033a8/0x023033b4 overwrite before its only read at 0x023033c8 (read).

handler: the materialised call target changes from C_BCM_HMI_AUDIO_CLIENT::Get_aux_status (0x025cb258, the saved setting) to C_BCM_HMI_AUDIO_CLIENT::Get_AUX_signal_status (0x025ccbe4); both take (this, T&) and the `lis r9,0x25d` before it is unchanged.
handler: `lwz` -> `lbz`. Get_AUX_signal_status writes a bool, one byte, where Get_aux_status wrote a long.
handler: the same `lwz` -> `lbz` at the activate/release decision.

C_HMI_MEDIA_APP_BASE::HandleDBUSMessage dispatch: drop the redundant reload of the message id (r0 already holds it from 0x0230961c; nothing in between writes r0) and move `cmplwi cr7,r0,0xd9` up one slot.
dispatch: `bgt cr7,0x02309650` moved up one slot, same target.
dispatch: `cmpwi cr7,r0,0xcb` moved up two slots.
dispatch: `beq cr7,0x02309fbc` (0xcb -> the AUX handler) moved up two slots, same target.
dispatch: the new case, `cmpwi cr7,r0,0xcc` (AUDIO_AUX_SIGNAL_STATUS_CHANGED). The unchanged `beq cr7,0x02309fbc` at 0x0230963c sends it to the AUX handler.
dispatch: `cmpwi cr7,r0,0xd7` moved up one slot, over a redundant reload.
dispatch: `beq cr7,0x0230a190` moved up one slot, same target.

dispatch: unconditional `b 0x0230a664`, the default case that 0x0230964c held, moved up one slot; 0x0230964c becomes unreachable. The conditional branch this slot held now sits at 0x02309644, so no condition is lost.
